description: Helps you decide what has to happen, by whom and when, for a deal to sign on time. You give the deal name and the target close date, plus the current stage, the buyer's champion, economic buyer and evaluators, known requirements and process steps if you have them. You get a close plan both sides can work from, with milestones, owners and dates. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of deal_strategy_coach when you need dated milestones and owners for an agreed close target.

blockers.description: Known blockers or concerns. Format is text. For example, "budget approval pending".

buyer_champion.description: Champion name and title. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

current_stage.description: Current deal stage. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "discovery".

deal_name.description: Deal/opportunity name. Format is text. For example, "annual renewal".

economic_buyer.description: Economic buyer name and title. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

known_process_steps.description: Known steps in their buying process, separated by semicolons or new lines (for example: Pilot; security review; procurement). Each step becomes its own milestone. Format is text.

known_requirements.description: Known requirements or evaluation criteria. Format is text. For example, "confirm who approves invoice exceptions".

procurement_contact.description: Procurement contact if known. Format is text. For example, "procurement lead and security reviewer".

target_close_date.description: Target close date (YYYY-MM-DD). A Saturday or Sunday date moves to the Friday before, and the plan says so. Format is text in YYYY-MM-DD form. For example, "2026-11-17".

technical_evaluators.description: Technical evaluators involved. Format is text. For example, "procurement lead and security reviewer".

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

your_solution.description: What you are selling. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

name: mutual_action_plan_generator
title: Mutual Action Plan Generator
